templates.name: Context flow · carried, layered, applied
templates.purpose: Three zones read left to right: context carried forward, a central panel with a five-step chain, and four numbered build activities, closed by a one-line shift statement.

slide.title: Persistent, agent-ready context can compress the path from prototype to production

body.text: Source code, components, data and controls, with confidence.
Steps, rules, exceptions and users linked to technology.
Approved outcomes, design choices and open questions.
Retrieve the right context for the next task instead of rediscovering it, with review and testing still authoritative.

templates.name: Foundation with Build and Sustain panels
templates.purpose: A shared-foundation card beside two stacked panels, one dark and one light, each with a how-it-is-used and a value-opportunity column, closed by a dark statement bar.

slide.title: Shared context supports both [[Build and Sustain]]

body.p: Governed retrieval connects the foundation to bounded work.

body.text: Retrieve process, rules, requirements and open questions for a bounded design, coding, testing or cutover task.
Warmer handoffs, faster prototyping, stronger traceability and earlier visibility of gaps.
Connect bug reports and change requests to documented intent, architecture and tests for impact analysis.
Faster investigation, better knowledge preservation and less maintenance effort over time.
The context layer compounds in value only while teams keep it current, governed and source-linked.

templates.name: Three patterns with decisions to validate
templates.purpose: Three stacked pattern rows, each with a coloured header, a flow line and role statement, and a right column of decisions to validate.

slide.title: Three patterns define the lakehouse role

source.text: West Monroe analysis of the Northfield data estate.

body.text: Pattern 1: Lakehouse as the analytics layer over the existing warehouse
Curated warehouse → Semantic services → BI layer
ROLE: Native analytics and consumption over data governed in the warehouse
Pattern 2: Lakehouse as the consumption layer for the engineering platform
Engineering platform → Curated layer → BI layer
ROLE: Business consumption while engineering and curation stay put
Ingestion and engineering → Lakehouse → Semantic and reporting
ROLE: One platform for qualified net-new workloads

templates.name: Two pathways with a left rail

slide.title: Governance runs through rollout and optimization

notes: Designed to align with Northfield’s governance structure, data enablement team and operational support functions.

body.text: Scale depends on clear decision rights, auditable controls and operational handoffs, not one-time enablement.
Two critical pathways to operationalize platform governance
01  Request intake: team to approved pattern access
02  Use-case intake: idea to governed build
Result: controlled scale, approval-only tool access and a repeatable model.
